## Description

Buys or sells event options based on a forecast of realized earnings movement versus pre-event implied volatility, often delta hedged.

## Where it may fit

Earnings events where the market's implied move is mispriced; risk profile is highly event- and ticker-specific.

## Vehicles

Equity volatility, event-driven options and market-making strategies.

## Required data

Historical event returns, timestamped earnings calendar, pre/post-event option chains, implied vol, Greeks, underlying quotes and hedge costs.

## Caveats

Implied-volatility collapse is not automatically profitable; the realized move, skew, IV changes and hedge slippage jointly determine results.
